title: Restructure the Product Registry data model by product class
requirements:
- Model units, strength, routes, storage conditions and classifications as structured, governed attributes
- Distinguish clinical concept, regulated product, item, packaging level, batch and serial instance
- Add applicability by product class and identification level to the data-element table
- Define a governed clinical-product model and identifier scheme
- Model repeatable packaging relationships down to the smallest base unit
- Make GTIN, brand name, medicinal attributes, origin, shelf life, dimensions and generic mapping conditional where not universally applicable
- Link manufacturers and related parties to authoritative organisation records
- Govern units and conversions, referencing UCUM where applicable, with integrity checks
